summary: v61h: tested vendor session-bound CSRF without the csrf cookie, the vendor path in /staff/auth/csrf, admin/staff/vendor regression, catalogue import progress and splitting of large PDFs (real Gemini), and the 5xx tolerance in RequireVendor. Everything requested works. Backend pytest: 15/15 passed. UI: after the csrf cookie and sessionStorage were dropped, a listing save and a catalogue upload each got 403, then GET /staff/auth/csrf returned 200, then the retry returned 200. Neither redirected to /login. The progress bar went 6% -> 68% -> done, and a 22-page PDF gave 22 products. A 32-page PDF was read in 3 parts, with pages_done going 0 -> 15 -> 30 -> 32. RequireVendor stayed on the page through two 503s from /vendor/auth/me and redirected only on a real 401.

minor.issue: Agent sessions are not handled. With only the agent_token cookie this returns 401, so agent CSRF recovery cannot work. It does not redirect, because of _skipAuthRedirect. Also, a browser holding an expired or invalid admin access_token AND a valid vendor_token gets 401 'Token expired' instead of the vendor token, because the vendor branch runs only when no access_token is present.

issues: The wording repeats 'of': 'AI is reading pages 1–15 of 22 of file.pdf'. Before pages_total is known it reads 'AI is reading the file of file.pdf'. Suggested: 'AI is reading pages 1–15 of 22 in <file>' and 'AI is reading <file>…'

action_items: Optional: fix the wording in the ImportProgress text (repeated 'of')
Optional: in refresh_csrf_token, fall back to the vendor and agent sessions when the access_token is missing or invalid

Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md: in preview, certifier@pmcmanagers.com rejects Certify@123 and 1234567890, and accounts@ / Accts@123 fails too. legal@ / Legal@123 and committee@ / Bid@1234 work. Staff login also requires active_role in the body.
critical_code_review_comments: require_csrf: the vendor HMAC is bound to the 'vendor:'+sub namespace. An admin csrf sent with a vendor cookie is correctly rejected with 403 (verified).
RequireVendor: after 6 non-401 failures (about 52 s) it falls through to 'authed'. This is acceptable, because the API interceptor still redirects on a real 401.
_run_import: updated_at is refreshed after each 15-page part, so the 8-minute stale check measures time per part, not per whole file. This is fine.
